tooltip.jaymoskitchen.unpurified_water: Unpurified: it may make you sick. Boil it over a fire or run it through a water filter
tooltip.jaymoskitchen.water_filter: Hold water in your other hand and use this to run it through
message.jaymoskitchen.water_filter.nothi: Hold unpurified water in your other hand
jei.jaymoskitchen.purifying_water: Water from a river, pond or rain-filled cauldron is unpurified, and drinking it may give you a parasite. To purify a bottle or a waterskin, use it on a lit campfire, firepit, bonfire or hearth, or on a cooking pot or frying pan standing over heat. A glass bottle dipped in a water cauldron standing over heat comes out full of Clean Water. A Water Filter (cloth, charcoal and sand) cleans the water held in your other hand, one use per bottle or per sip in a waterskin. Every bottle of water gives you its glass bottle back once you drink it.
